faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NDMA Consultant (Awards) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NDMA Consultant (Awards) position is 07 September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant (Awards) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in any field from a recognized University. A Master's in Data Science is considered desirable for this role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 40 years. However, retired government employees may be considered up to the age of 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (Awards) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 75,000 to Rs. 1,00,000.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant (Awards) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Consultant (Awards) post in the National Disaster Management Authority.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this recruitment must be submitted online through the official NDMA website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Consultant (Awards) role?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an application screening stage to evaluate the eligibility and suitability of the candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity with the National Disaster Management Authority.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
